crossRefs.note: A nation which you don’t know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work. You will only be oppressed and…
They will eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground, until you are destroyed. They also won’t leave…
So it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites, the Amalekites, and the children of the east came up against them.
You will sow, but won’t reap. You will tread the olives, but won’t anoint yourself with oil; and crush grapes, but…

translations.web: They cut their food in the field. They glean the vineyard of the wicked.
translations.bsb: They gather fodder in the fields and glean the vineyards of the wicked.
translations.kjv: They reap every one his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.
translations.asv: They cut their provender in the field; And they glean the vintage of the wicked.
